cohort: The study reviews literature concerning patients who experience retained products of conception after miscarriage, planned termination of pregnancy, term spontaneous vaginal delivery, or caesarean section.
finding: Gray scale and Color Doppler ultrasound are the first-line modality for RPOC diagnosis, but hysteroscopic resection of placental remnants without electricity seems to be the best treatment option due to low risks and fewer fertility-related complications.
mod_finding: Retained products of conception can occur after both term spontaneous vaginal delivery and caesarean section, indicating mode of birth as a context for the condition.
